qa.method: render_pixelspec.py: every published frame PNG is read back and measured with codeart_core.qa_pixels against the resolved palette of its variant (alpha census, exact palette lookup and, with an outline, 4-neighbour outline gaps and L-corners); each check is the worst frame against its gate in codeart_core.QA_PIXEL_GATES
notProven: Readability, silhouette and appeal at game scale; check them on a review sheet (pixel_qa.py --review).
Motion, timing and spacing between frames; numbers do not judge animation quality.
That the art matches the brief and the intent of the spec.

preview.layout: rows are variants, columns are distinct frames
